module: Flowgraph node "Toggle Walking" (category repeat_instant, depends on gameplay_walk). Input pulses enterWalking (switches to walking mode, with optional pos/rot) and exitWalking (enters the nearest vehicle). Output pulses success / fail. When entering walking mode, the vehicle left behind is added to the flowgraph vehicle module (ignoreReadyUp).

work.desc: Calls gameplay_walk.setWalkingMode(true, pos, rot) or (false) depending on the received pulse, then writes success/fail.
